api_note: GA4 Data API (analyticsdata.googleapis.com) — NOT Google Ads API. Does not consume the Ads developer-token ops budget.

metric_labels.ad_ctr: Ad CTR — clicks ÷ impressions in Google Ads
metric_labels.stayed_and_looked: Stayed and looked around — engaged sessions ÷ sessions
metric_labels.left_right_away: Left right away — sessions that were not engaged

quota_note: GA4 standard properties typically allow on the order of 25k–200k tokens/day (property-dependent). A few small RunReport calls are negligible. Separate from Google Ads API quota (~15k ops/day).

landing_compare.note: Path buckets from landingPage dimension. Role LPs = /us/* except home/quiz.

device_finding.note: Paid Search 79% mobile — in line with search-ad expectations.

insights: Most paid clicks still open the US home page — role ads exist, but Final URLs haven’t shifted traffic onto role pages yet.
“Direct” is 12 sessions (Paid Search 244): typed URL, bookmarks, team checks, and some paid clicks that lose the ad tag — not mysterious organic growth.
Engagement rate is saturated (100% — every session met GA4’s 10s / 2-page / key-event bar), so it does not discriminate health. Avg session 1m 03s. (Website behavior — not Ad CTR.)
Paid Search is mostly mobile (79% — 192 vs 52 desktop), as expected for search ads.
This US property has no /au landings — Australia tags go to a separate AU property.
notes: US site tags only. Australia is a separate GA4 property — see the AU block.
